license_required.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice professional nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state or use any title, sign, abbreviation, card, or device to indicate that such person is a practicing professional nurse, practical nurse, or advanced practice nurse unless he or she has been duly licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Professional Registration, Department of Commerce and Insurance
umbrella_agency.quote: The following boards and commissions are assigned by specific type transfers to the division of professional registration: ... Missouri state board of nursing, chapter 335

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant shall be of good moral character

degree_required.value: High school diploma or equivalent; completion of basic professional curriculum in accredited or approved school of nursing with professional nursing degree or diploma (RN); or two years high school and basic prescribed curriculum in state-accredited or approved school of nursing with nursing degree, certificate or diploma (LPN)
degree_required.quote: have completed at least the high school course of study, or the equivalent thereof as determined by the state board of education, and have successfully completed the basic professional curriculum in an accredited or approved school of nursing and earned a professional nursing degree or diploma

exams.name: NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN
exams.quote: shall pass an examination as required by the board

interval_years.quote: The license of every person licensed under the provisions of this chapter shall be renewed as provided

available.quote: The board shall issue a license to practice nursing as an advanced practice registered nurse, a registered professional nurse, or a licensed practical nurse without examination to an applicant who has duly become licensed as an advanced practice registered nurse, registered nurse, or licensed practical nurse pursuant to the laws of another state, territory, or foreign country if the applicant meets the qualifications required of advanced practice registered nurses, registered nurses, or licensed practical nurses in this state at the time the applicant was originally licensed in the other state, territory, or foreign country.

requirements.value: Applicant must have been licensed in another state, territory, or foreign country and must meet the qualifications that were required in that jurisdiction at the time of original licensure. Temporary permits available for up to 12 months.
requirements.quote: The board shall issue a license to practice nursing as an advanced practice registered nurse, a registered professional nurse, or a licensed practical nurse without examination to an applicant who has duly become licensed as an advanced practice registered nurse, registered nurse, or licensed practical nurse pursuant to the laws of another state, territory, or foreign country if the applicant meets the qualifications required of advanced practice registered nurses, registered nurses, or licensed practical nurses in this state at the time the applicant was originally licensed in the other state, territory, or foreign country.

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice professional nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state or use any title, sign, abbreviation, card, or device to indicate that such person is a practicing professional nurse, practical nurse, or advanced practice nurse unless he or she has been duly licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

credential_type.quote: the issuing of a license to candidates who have met the requirements specified under this chapter, authorizing the person to engage in the practice of advanced practice, professional, or practical nursing

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice professional nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state or use any title, sign, abbreviation, card, or device to indicate that such person is a practicing professional nurse, practical nurse, or advanced practice nurse unless he or she has been duly licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

title_protection.quote: Any person who holds a license to practice professional nursing in this state may use the title "Registered Professional Nurse" and the abbreviation "RN". No other person shall use the title "Registered Professional Nurse" or the abbreviation "RN". No other person shall assume any title or use any abbreviation or any other words, letters, signs, or devices to indicate that the person using the same is a registered professional nurse.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall practice or offer to practice professional nursing, practical nursing, or advanced practice nursing in this state or use any title, sign, abbreviation, card, or device to indicate that such person is a practicing professional nurse, practical nurse, or advanced practice nurse unless he or she has been duly licensed under the provisions of this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use or unlawful possession of controlled substances or alcoholic beverages to an extent impairing ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use or unlawful possession of any controlled substance, as defined in chapter 195, by the federal government, or by the department of health and senior services by regulation, regardless of impairment, or alcoholic beverage to an extent that such use impairs a person's ability to perform the work of any profession licensed or regulated by sections 335.011 to 335.096.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction for offense reasonably related to qualifications, functions or duties, or involving fraud, dishonesty, or moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The person has been finally adjudicated and found guilty, or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere, in a criminal prosecution pursuant to the laws of any state or of the United States, for any offense reasonably related to the qualifications, functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated pursuant to sections 335.011 to 335.096, for any offense an essential element of which is fraud, dishonesty or an act of violence, or for any offense involving moral turpitude, whether or not sentence is imposed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing license or obtaining permission to take examination
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of fraud, deception, misrepresentation or bribery in securing any certificate of registration or authority, permit or license issued pursuant to sections 335.011 to 335.096 or in obtaining permission to take any examination given or required pursuant to sections 335.011 to 335.096

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining or attempting to obtain fees by fraud, deception or misrepresentation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining or attempting to obtain any fee, charge, tuition or other compensation by fraud, deception or misrepresentation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetency, gross negligence, or repeated negligence in performance of professional duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Incompetency, gross negligence, or repeated negligence in the performance of the functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter. For the purposes of this subdivision, "repeated negligence" means the failure, on more than one occasion, to use that degree of skill and learning ordinarily used under the same or similar circumstances by the member of the applicant's or licensee's profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misconduct, fraud, misrepresentation, dishonesty, unethical conduct, or unprofessional conduct in performance of professional duties
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misconduct, fraud, misrepresentation, dishonesty, unethical conduct, or unprofessional conduct in the performance of the functions or duties of any profession licensed or regulated by this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully and continually overcharging or overtreating patients; charging for visits that did not occur or services not rendered
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully and continually overcharging or overtreating patients; or charging for visits which did not occur unless the services were contracted for in advance, or for services which were not rendered or documented in the patient's records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Attempting to obtain or retain patient through intimidation, coercion or deception; discouraging second opinion
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Attempting, directly or indirectly, by way of intimidation, coercion or deception, to obtain or retain a patient or discourage the use of a second opinion or consultation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully and continually performing inappropriate or unnecessary treatment, diagnostic tests, or nursing services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully and continually performing inappropriate or unnecessary treatment, diagnostic tests, or nursing services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Delegating professional responsibilities to unqualified person
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Delegating professional responsibilities to a person who is not qualified by training, skill, competency, age, experience, or licensure to perform such responsibilities

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing nursing services beyond authorized scope of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing nursing services beyond the authorized scope of practice for which the individual is licensed in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Exercising influence within nurse-patient relationship for purposes of engaging patient in sexual activity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Exercising influence within a nurse-patient relationship for purposes of engaging a patient in sexual activity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Being listed on any state or federal sexual offender registry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Being listed on any state or federal sexual offender registry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate with board during investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure of any applicant or licensee to cooperate with the board during any investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with subpoena or board order
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with any subpoena or subpoena duces tecum from the board or an order of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to timely pay license renewal fees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to timely pay license renewal fees specified in this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating probation agreement, order, or settlement agreement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating a probation agreement, order, or other settlement agreement with this board or any other licensing agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to inform board of current residence within 30 days of change
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to inform the board of the nurse's current residence within thirty days of changing residence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any other conduct that is unethical or unprofessional involving a minor
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any other conduct that is unethical or unprofessional involving a minor

disciplinary_grounds.description: Departure from or failure to conform to nursing standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A departure from or failure to conform to nursing standards

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to establish, maintain, or communicate professional boundaries with patient
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to establish, maintain, or communicate professional boundaries with the patient. A nurse may provide health care services to a person with whom the nurse has a personal relationship as long as the nurse otherwise meets the standards of the profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating confidentiality or privacy rights of patient, resident, or client
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating the confidentiality or privacy rights of the patient, resident, or client

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to assess, accurately document, or report status of patient; falsely assessing, documenting, or reporting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to assess, accurately document, or report the status of a patient, resident, or client, or falsely assessing, documenting, or reporting the status of a patient, resident, or client

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally or negligently causing physical or emotional harm to patient, resident, or client
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally or negligently causing physical or emotional harm to a patient, resident, or client

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to furnish appropriate details of patient's nursing needs to succeeding nurses
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to furnish appropriate details of a patient's, client's, or resident's nursing needs to succeeding nurses legally qualified to provide continuing nursing services to a patient, client, or resident

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of or assisting any person to violate any provision of nursing practice act or lawful rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of, or assisting or enabling any person to violate, any provision of sections 335.011 to 335.096, or of any lawful rule or regulation adopted pursuant to sections 335.011 to 335.096

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impersonation of licensed nurse or allowing person to use license or diploma
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impersonation of any person holding a certificate of registration or authority, permit or license or allowing any person to use his or her certificate of registration or authority, permit, license or diploma from any school

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action against license in another state, territory, federal agency or country on grounds for which revocation or suspension authorized in Missouri
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disciplinary action against the holder of a license or other right to practice any profession regulated by sections 335.011 to 335.096 granted by another state, territory, federal agency or country upon grounds for which revocation or suspension is authorized in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Person finally adjudged insane or incompetent by court of competent jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A person is finally adjudged insane or incompetent by a court of competent jurisdiction

disciplinary_grounds.description: Assisting or enabling unlicensed person to practice nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Assisting or enabling any person to practice or offer to practice any profession licensed or regulated by sections 335.011 to 335.096 who is not registered and currently eligible to practice pursuant to sections 335.011 to 335.096

disciplinary_grounds.description: Issuance of license based upon material mistake of fact
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Issuance of a certificate of registration or authority, permit or license based upon a material mistake of fact

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any professional trust or confidence
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any professional trust or confidence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, misleading or deceptive advertisement or solicitation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Use of any advertisement or solicitation which is false, misleading or deceptive to the general public or persons to whom the advertisement or solicitation is primarily directed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of drug laws or rules and regulations of state, other state, or federal government
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the drug laws or rules and regulations of this state, any other state or the federal government

disciplinary_grounds.description: Placement on employee disqualification list or related restriction by state or federal government
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Placement on an employee disqualification list or other related restriction or finding pertaining to employment within a health-related profession issued by any state or federal government or agency following final disposition by such state or federal government or agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to successfully complete intervention or alternative program for substance use disorder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to successfully complete the intervention or alternative program for substance use disorder

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making or causing false statement or misrepresentation for Medicaid or Medicare payment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making or causing to be made a false statement or misrepresentation of a material fact, with intent to defraud, for payment pursuant to the provisions of chapter 208 or chapter 630, or for payment from Title XVIII or Title XIX of the federal Medicare program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to guard against contagious diseases or maintain sanitary conditions
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure or refusal to properly guard against contagious, infectious, or communicable diseases or the spread thereof; maintaining an unsanitary office or performing professional services under unsanitary conditions; or failure to report the existence of an unsanitary condition in the office of a physician or in any health care facility to the board, in writing, within thirty days after the discovery thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Pattern of personal use or consumption of controlled substance or prescription medication abuse
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A pattern of personal use or consumption of any controlled substance or any substance which requires a prescription unless it is prescribed, dispensed, or administered by a provider who is authorized by law to do so or a pattern of abuse of any prescription medication

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual intoxication or dependence on alcohol
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual intoxication or dependence on alcohol, evidence of which may include more than one alcohol-related enforcement contact as defined by section 302.525

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with treatment program or aftercare program
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with a treatment program or an aftercare program entered into as part of a board order, settlement agreement, or licensee's professional health program

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to submit to drug or alcohol screening when requested
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to submit to a drug or alcohol screening when requested by an employer or by the board. Failure to submit to a drug or alcohol screening shall create the presumption that the test would have been positive for a drug for which the individual did not have a prescription in a drug screening or positive for alcohol in an alcohol screening

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adjudged in need of guardian or conservator and not restored to capacity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Adjudged by a court in need of a guardian or conservator, or both, obtaining a guardian or conservator, or both, and who has not been restored to capacity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Diversion or attempting to divert medication, controlled substance, or medical supplies
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Diversion or attempting to divert any medication, controlled substance, or medical supplies

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to answer, disclose, or fully provide information requested on application or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to answer, failure to disclose, or failure to fully provide all information requested on any application or renewal for a license. This includes disclosing all pleas of guilt or findings of guilt in a case where the imposition of sentence was suspended, whether or not the case is now confidential

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical or mental illness or disability impairing ability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical or mental illness, including but not limited to deterioration through the aging process or loss of motor skill, or disability that impairs the licensee's ability to practice the profession with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety. This does not include temporary illness which is expected to resolve within a short period of time

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct that constitutes serious danger to health, safety, or welfare of patient or public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct that constitutes a serious danger to the health, safety, or welfare of a patient or the public.

definition_quote.value: The practice of professional nursing is the performance for compensation of any act or action which requires substantial specialized education, judgment and skill based on knowledge and application of principles derived from the biological, physical, social, behavioral, and nursing sciences, including, but not limited to: (a) Responsibility for the promotion and teaching of health care and the prevention of illness to the patient and his or her family; (b) Assessment, data collection, nursing diagnosis, nursing care, evaluation, and counsel of persons who are ill, injured, or experiencing alterations in normal health processes; (c) The administration of medications and treatments as prescribed by a person licensed by a state regulatory board to prescribe medications and treatments; (d) The coordination and assistance in the determination and delivery of a plan of health care with all members of a health team; (e) The teaching and supervision of other persons in the performance of any of the foregoing

methods_authorized.quote: Assessment, data collection, nursing diagnosis, nursing care, evaluation, and counsel of persons who are ill, injured, or experiencing alterations in normal health processes; The administration of medications and treatments as prescribed by a person licensed by a state regulatory board to prescribe medications and treatments; The coordination and assistance in the determination and delivery of a plan of health care with all members of a health team; The teaching and supervision of other persons in the performance of any of the foregoing

drug_authority.value: Administration of medications and treatments as prescribed by a person licensed by a state regulatory board to prescribe medications and treatments
drug_authority.quote: The administration of medications and treatments as prescribed by a person licensed by a state regulatory board to prescribe medications and treatments

value: Advanced Practice Registered Nurse (APRN) - including Certified Clinical Nurse Specialist, Certified Nurse Midwife, Certified Nurse Practitioner, Certified Registered Nurse Anesthetist
license_tiers.quote: Advanced practice registered nurse or APRN, a person who is licensed under the provisions of this chapter to engage in the practice of advanced practice nursing as a certified clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse midwife, certified nurse practitioner, or certified registered nurse anesthetist

aprn_role_categories.quote: Advanced practice registered nurse or APRN, a person who is licensed under the provisions of this chapter to engage in the practice of advanced practice nursing as a certified clinical nurse specialist, certified nurse midwife, certified nurse practitioner, or certified registered nurse anesthetist

value: Person licensed by a state regulatory board to prescribe medications and treatments
lpn_supervision_requirements.quote: All such nursing care shall be given under the direction of a person licensed by a state regulatory board to prescribe medications and treatments or under the direction of a registered professional nurse. For the purposes of this chapter, the term "direction" shall mean guidance or supervision provided by a person licensed by a state regulatory board to prescribe medications and treatments or a registered professional nurse, including, but not limited to, oral, written, or otherwise communicated orders or directives for patient care.

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: Has a controlled substance prescribing authority delegated in the collaborative practice arrangement under section 334.104 with a physician who has an unrestricted federal Drug Enforcement Administration registration number and who is actively engaged in a practice comparable in scope, specialty, or expertise to that of the advanced practice registered nurse.

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: The board of nursing may grant a certificate of controlled substance prescriptive authority to an advanced practice registered nurse

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: A multistate license to practice registered or licensed practical or vocational nursing issued by a home state to a resident in that state shall be recognized by each party state as authorizing a nurse to practice as a registered nurse, "RN", or as a licensed practical or vocational nurse, "LPN" or "VN", under a multistate licensure privilege, in each party state.

multistate_license_option_available.quote: A multistate license to practice registered or licensed practical or vocational nursing issued by a home state to a resident in that state shall be recognized by each party state as authorizing a nurse to practice as a registered nurse, "RN", or as a licensed practical or vocational nurse, "LPN" or "VN", under a multistate licensure privilege, in each party state.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The state board of nursing may establish an intervention program and an alternative program to promote the identification, intervention, treatment, and monitoring of nurses or applicants for a nursing license who may be impaired by reason of substance abuse or the potential for substance abuse.

telehealth_prescribing_rules.value: An advanced practice registered nurse (APRN) providing nursing services under a collaborative practice arrangement may provide such services outside the geographic proximity requirements if the collaborating physician and advanced practice registered nurse utilize telehealth. Telehealth providers shall be required to obtain patient consent before telehealth services are initiated and ensure confidentiality of medical information.
telehealth_prescribing_rules.quote: An advanced practice registered nurse (APRN) providing nursing services under a collaborative practice arrangement under section 334.104 may provide such services outside the geographic proximity requirements of section 334.104 if the collaborating physician and advanced practice registered nurse utilize telehealth. Telehealth providers shall be required to obtain patient consent before telehealth services are initiated and ensure confidentiality of medical information.

nurse_practitioner_transition_to_practic.quote: Provides evidence of a minimum of one thousand hours of practice in an advanced practice nursing category prior to application for a certificate of prescriptive authority. The one thousand hours shall not include clinical hours obtained in the advanced practice nursing education program.

military_education_credit_required.quote: Every examination and professional licensing board in this state shall adopt necessary procedures to implement the provisions of this section.
